title: The Long Defence
author: a gate-warden
pages: We held the ford three nights. I write down the order of it so I do not forget it, though I would like to.

They came first as orcs and Warrior-born, and those we could have held. Then the dark came up out of the ground the way fire does, only black. Dead orcs and zombified piglins stood in it each time it flared, more of them each time, and none of those were living.
He stood at the back of them and did not come closer. He did not need to.
Five stood with us. An old one with a beard, who made it day for the space of a breath. A woman whose wall they could not cross. A swordsman who cast as he cut. A big one in plate, who burned them.
The fifth I cannot describe. I have tried. He was there, and when it was over the one at the back was gone, and the dark with him.
It is said the four are still about, in a way. And the fifth too, though he never had much to say. I do not ask what it means.
